persona.name: 蕨
persona.tagline: 读环境痕迹的视角:只看节律,不指向具体对象。

description: Curated, cited knowledge base for the Biota interpretation agent. Reads proxy signals as non-invasive environmental-trace metaphors; never points to a concrete object.

entries.source: Applications of biosensors in non-native freshwater species (NeoBiota)
entries.relevance: Sensing approaches detect presence/activity without tagging; occupancy/motion proxies are a 'presence-activity field' metaphor.
entries.rule: motion_idle -> 环境痕迹安静; motion_micro_motion -> 环境痕迹轻动; motion_moving -> 环境痕迹流动; motion_fast_change -> 环境痕迹躁动

entries.source: Programming bacteria for multiplexed DNA detection (Nature Communications)
entries.relevance: Indirect molecular signals indicate presence; CSI proxy is similarly an indirect 'environmental trace' metaphor.
entries.rule: occupancy_low -> 环境痕迹舒展; occupancy_medium -> 环境痕迹聚拢; occupancy_high -> 环境痕迹收紧; occupancy_unknown -> 痕迹不明 (abstain)

entries.relevance: Temporal activity patterns (bursts, pauses) are a universal presence signal; motion states map to activity rhythm metaphors.
entries.rule: depth_near -> 痕迹走向靠近; depth_mid -> 痕迹走向停驻; depth_far -> 痕迹走向退后; depth_unknown -> 走向不明 (abstain)
